description: A shell script to determine the source date epoch by checking version files, version control logs, file modification time, or defaulting to empty.

methods.name: try_version
methods.description: Checks for a version date file and reads the date if present.

methods.name: try_git
methods.description: Gets the latest commit time from git log.

methods.name: try_hg
methods.description: Gets the latest commit date from hg log.

methods.name: try_mtime
methods.description: Gets the modification time of the script itself.
